title: [finding] page.zod.ts visibleWhen .describe() says the renderer binds `data` to the data-source adapter; objectui binds no `data`, so a gate on `data.total` faults and shows in both polarities (twin of #17203, which removed `app`)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2777 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2811). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

The spec tells an author that a page component's `visibleWhen` can read `data` (the bound data source). The shipping renderer binds no `data` there. A gate written from the describe, such as `data.total > 0`, faults; the renderer fails open, so the component shows whether the predicate is true or false. An AI author following the contract text ships a gate that never gates, and nothing refuses it.

## Evidence

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:439` on `main` `9432bac0`+: the `visibleWhen` describe says "The shipping renderer additionally mounts `features`, `os.user` and binds `data` to the data-source ADAPTER here". The docblock above it (「Ambient roots」, `:414`) says the same.
- objectui `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:665-676` on objectui `main`: `configEvaluationScope` builds `{ ...predicateScope, current_user, record?, page }`; there is no `data`. objectstack-ai/objectui#9308 (closed, ruling 2026-09-13 option B) is where the data scope left that seam.
- Measured by the cloud#2777 dev through objectui's `SchemaRenderer` at `d758f2f2`: `visibleWhen { dialect: 'cel', source: 'data.total > 0' }` and `'data.total == 0'` both render SHOWN.
- The consumer that followed the describe: the cloud#2777 v1 design (a progress checklist switched on bound counts). It was measured and moved to v2 (objectstack-ai/cloud#2801).
- #17203 (closed) corrected the same describe for `app` (option B, batch #67); `data` was left.

## Wanted

The describe and the 「Ambient roots」 docblock say what the renderer mounts: `record`, `current_user` (and its aliases), `page`, `features`, `os.user`; not `data`. If binding `data` is wanted instead, that is a renderer change in objectui, and the describe follows it. Either way the contract text and the renderer agree.

Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for `visibleWhen data root`, "binds data to the data-source"; only #17203 (closed, the `app` twin) matched.
